verdict.rationale: Reflect's API docs link to a full OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec hosted on openpm (openpm.ai/packages/reflect/openapi.json). It covers graphs, links, daily notes, notes and users/me with OAuth2 scopes, so an AI-native user can download a machine-readable spec. The vendor's own domain serves no spec: all candidate OpenAPI paths return 404. That does not contradict the claim, since the docs point to the openpm-hosted file. Missing for 10: first-party-hosted spec on the vendor domain, versioning/deprecation policy for the spec (it sits at 0.1.0), independent or hands-on confirmation that the openpm spec matches the live API.
